#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import sys
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
TODAY = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def create_cover_pdf(path: str) -> None:
    """Create a standalone cover page PDF."""
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    rule_y = height / 2 + 0.5 * inch
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.35, 0.6)
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    c.line(width * 0.25, rule_y, width * 0.75, rule_y)

    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2, TITLE)

    c.setFont("Helvetica", 14)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 0.7 * inch, TODAY)

    c.save()
    print(f"Created cover page: {path} (title: {TITLE!r}, date: {TODAY})")


def merge_cover_with_report(cover_path: str, report_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    """Prepend the cover page to the existing report."""
    reader = PdfReader(report_path)
    writer = PdfWriter()

    cover = PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0]
    writer.add_page(cover)

    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(output_path, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(f"Merged cover + report -> {output_path} ({len(writer.pages)} total pages)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    report = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else INPUT_PDF
    cover = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else COVER_PDF
    output = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else OUTPUT_PDF

    create_cover_pdf(cover)
    merge_cover_with_report(cover, report, output)
